name: glb-designer-stage6e
description: Asset Studio Iteration 2 Stage 6e — realism II in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Two identical velvet (sheen) plumped cushions side by side: the LEFT one has fabric Wrinkles at 0.8, the RIGHT one has Wrinkles 0 (smooth). Close in front + 3/4 so the wrinkle relief breaks up the highlight/sheen on the left cushion while the right reads as a smooth bulged shell. Then Save and assert the persisted UserGltfDef's assetSpec (v10 envelope) embeds parts[].wrinkles — the realism layer round-trips as an editable spec. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 (sheen needs a real GPU).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: build-wrinkle-scene
steps.comment: Two identical velvet-sheen plumped cushions. LEFT: wrinkles 0.8 (fabric). RIGHT: wrinkles 0 (smooth control). Same colour/plump/sheen so only the wrinkle normal map differs.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); const base = { kind: 'box', color: '#3f6389', size: [0.52, 0.22, 0.52], plump: 0.85, sheen: 1, sheenRoughness: 0.3, sheenColor: '#b9cbe0', roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0 }; s.parts = [ Object.assign({ id: 'cushion-wrinkled', name: 'Wrinkled', position: [-0.32, 0.16, 0], wrinkles: 0.8 }, base), Object.assign({ id: 'cushion-smooth', name: 'Smooth', position: [0.32, 0.16, 0], wrinkles: 0 }, base) ]; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: assert-spec-fields
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const w = s.parts.find(p => p.id === 'cushion-wrinkled'); const sm = s.parts.find(p => p.id === 'cushion-smooth'); if (!w || !sm) throw new Error('cushions missing'); if (w.wrinkles !== 0.8) throw new Error('wrinkled cushion should be 0.8, got ' + w.wrinkles); if (sm.wrinkles !== 0) throw new Error('smooth cushion should be 0, got ' + sm.wrinkles); if ((w.plump ?? 0) <= 0 || (sm.plump ?? 0) <= 0) throw new Error('both must be plumped'); if (!w.sheen || !sm.sheen) throw new Error('both must be velvet (sheen)'); })()

steps.name: front-view
steps.comment: Head-on front: the crowned tops catch the directional highlight — the left cushion's creases break it up, the right stays a clean smooth bulge.
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Front view"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('Front view button not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: home-view
steps.comment: 3/4 iso (Home): the sheen at grazing angle on the sides + crown shows the fabric wrinkle response vs the smooth control.
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Home view"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('Home view button not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage6e Wrinkles'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-wrinkles
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved assetSpec (v10 envelope) embeds parts[].wrinkles — 0.8 on the wrinkled cushion, 0 on the smooth control — so the Stage-6e realism layer round-trips as an editable spec.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage6e Wrinkles' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.assetSpec); if (env.v !== 10) return false; const s = env.payload; const w = s.parts.find(p => p.id === 'cushion-wrinkled'); const sm = s.parts.find(p => p.id === 'cushion-smooth'); return w && w.wrinkles === 0.8 && sm && sm.wrinkles === 0; } catch { return false } })())

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed parts[].wrinkles (0.8 wrinkled, 0 smooth) at the v10 envelope
